title: Apple announces Siri AI and its next generation of Apple Intelligence
raw_excerpt: Two years after first revealing its plans for Apple Intelligence and a smarter Siri that never fully materialized, at WWDC, Apple just revealed a new set of AI features and a smarter, more personalized Siri. Apple calls Siri AI an "entirely new version of Siri" and says it's both more conversational and more capable than the previous version of the smart assistant. In conversations, it has a more expressive voice that can be customized by pace, expressivity, and accent. Siri AI will be accessible systemwide, capable of reading what's onscreen and interacting with your apps. summary: 苹果在WWDC 2026上正式发布全新Siri AI，这是两年前Apple Intelligence计划中承诺但未实现的智能助手升级。新版Siri AI具备更自然的对话能力，可自定义语速、表现力和口音，能系统级读取屏幕内容并与应用交互，还推出独立Siri App支持对话历史跨设备同步。此举标志着苹果在AI助手领域的关键追赶，对iPhone、iPad、Mac等全生态产生深远影响。

title: OpenAI files for IPO, following Anthropic
raw_excerpt: OpenAI on Monday checked off a preliminary step in the IPO race that it and rival Anthropic have been competing in for the better part of a year: The company announced it has confidentially submitted a Form S-1 with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, following Anthropic's decision to do the same on June 1st. The confidential filing means that certain details normally available through the form - such as executive compensation figures, potential risks to a company's business, and more financials - aren't yet public. As of Anthropic's most recent fundraise, it's being called the world's most valuable startup, with a post-money valu … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI于6月8日向美国SEC秘密提交S-1表格，正式启动IPO流程，紧随竞争对手Anthropic于6月1日的类似动作。秘密提交意味着高管薪酬、财务风险等细节暂不公开。此举标志着AI行业两大领军企业同时进入资本市场，将深刻影响AI产业的融资格局和商业化路径。

title: Apple reveals new AI architecture built around Google Gemini models
summary: 苹果在WWDC上披露其新一代AI架构已引入谷歌Gemini模型，标志着两大科技巨头在AI领域的罕见合作。该架构将支撑Siri AI及Apple Intelligence的底层能力，通过整合外部顶尖模型提升苹果设备的AI性能。这一合作既反映了苹果自研AI的挑战，也体现了AI生态中开放与封闭策略的博弈。

title: Making Claude a chemist
raw_excerpt: Anthropic's AI model Claude performs well in predicting NMR spectra, matching and sometimes surpassing traditional tools like ChemDraw and MestReNova. Opus 4.7, a Claude variant, accurately predicted hydrogen and carbon shifts on average and demonstrated consistency in replicating results. The AI also proposes chemical structures from spectral data, showing promise in reverse engineering molecular structures, a task typically requiring more complex tools.
summary: Anthropic发布研究，展示其Claude模型在预测NMR（核磁共振）波谱方面表现优异，平均准确预测氢和碳化学位移，性能媲美甚至超越ChemDraw、MestReNova等传统专业工具。Claude还能从波谱数据反向推导化学结构，展示了AI在化学领域从辅助到自主解析的潜力，为科学AI应用开辟新方向。

title: NotebookLM’s Gemini 3.5 upgrade adds a cloud computer and help finding sources
raw_excerpt: Google is rolling out "across the board" updates to NotebookLM. The AI-powered note-taking app now uses Google's upgraded Gemini 3.5 model , which will allow it to respond with "more accurate and reliable information," according to a blog post on Monday . Launched in 2023 , NotebookLM allows you to interact with your notes and sources using AI, as well as ask questions about the materials. With this update, Google says you can start a research project by just asking NotebookLM questions about a topic, instead of importing notes or YouTube videos. NotebookLM will use Google Search to help you find relevant sources, building on its "discover" fe … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google为NotebookLM推出重大更新，升级至Gemini 3.5模型，使其能提供更准确可靠的信息。新功能允许用户直接通过提问开始研究项目，NotebookLM会利用Google搜索帮助寻找来源，无需手动导入笔记或视频。这标志着AI笔记工具从“分析已有材料”向“主动研究助手”的进化。

title: Gemma 4 QAT models: Optimizing model compression for mobile and laptop efficiency
raw_excerpt: Google released Gemma 4 checkpoints optimized with Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) to enhance efficiency on mobile and laptops. QAT minimizes performance loss during model compression, enabling models to run on everyday edge devices. The update includes a specialized mobile quantization format, significantly reducing memory requirements while maintaining model quality.
summary: Google发布Gemma 4的量化感知训练（QAT）优化版本，专为移动设备和笔记本电脑设计。QAT技术能在模型压缩过程中最小化性能损失，大幅降低内存需求，使大模型能在边缘设备高效运行。此举降低了端侧AI部署门槛，对移动AI应用和隐私保护计算具有重要意义。

title: Amazon is launching AI-generated custom merch
raw_excerpt: Amazon is expanding its print-on-demand features to AI-generated designs created using Alexa for Shopping for products like T-shirts, water bottles, and hoodies. Shoppers can use text prompts to generate images that are then printed onto blanks for sale on Amazon. They can then share the link to the design so other people can buy the same custom item. Amazon offers family reunions and pet-themed designs as use case examples, but the feature also threatens an entire ecosystem of drop-shipped products - as well as other custom printing companies. summary: 亚马逊推出AI生成定制商品功能，用户可通过Alexa for Shopping用文字描述生成图像，并印制在T恤、水瓶、连帽衫等产品上。生成的定制商品可分享链接供他人购买。该功能直接威胁现有按需打印和代发货生态系统，展示了AI在电商个性化领域的颠覆性应用。

title: Microsoft rolls out Scout AI agent to Frontier users
raw_excerpt: Microsoft Scout is an always-on agent for Frontier program users that enhances automation in the Microsoft 365 stack. Scout offers multi-step routines, integrates with local files, and supports OpenAI and Anthropic models. While currently gated, it positions Microsoft strategically in the persistent agents space against competitors.
summary: 微软向Frontier计划用户推出Scout AI Agent，这是一个始终在线的智能助手，深度集成Microsoft 365套件。Scout支持多步骤自动化任务、本地文件操作，并可调用OpenAI和Anthropic模型。此举标志着微软在持久化AI Agent领域的战略布局，与谷歌、苹果形成直接竞争。

title: OpenAI Adds Lockdown Mode
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduced Lockdown Mode to reduce exposure to prompt injection attacks from webpages and external content. The feature disables live browsing, web image retrieval, deep research, and agent mode while keeping some cached content and image-generation functionality available.
summary: OpenAI推出Lockdown Mode（锁定模式），旨在减少来自网页和外部内容的提示注入攻击风险。该模式会禁用实时浏览、网页图像检索、深度研究和Agent模式，但保留部分缓存内容和图像生成功能。这是AI安全领域的重要实践，为防范恶意输入提供了新的防护机制。
